readyBody: Open it now to reveal your cards. They go to your vault, and you ship them whenever you're ready.
openedBody: You've opened your pack. See your card any time on My Packs.
pendingBody: Your payment went through. Your pack will be ready to open in a few seconds.
slowBody: This is taking a little longer than usual. Use the link in your order confirmation email to open your pack.
vaultHeading: Your Card Is In Your Vault
vaultBody: The card you bought from another collector is already in your Poke-Collect vault. Nothing ships yet; send it with the rest of your vault whenever you're ready.
